name: v9_receivables_quality_reversal
hypothesis: High receivables relative to sales can indicate lower earnings quality or collection risk. A mostly working-capital signal with only a small reversal stabilizer may diversify away from ROE/payout alphas.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * receivable / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Main signal is receivables quality; parent reversal weight capped to avoid LLpGdlrm/v7 correlation.

name: v9_inventory_turnover_quality
hypothesis: High inventory turnover can indicate operational efficiency. Combine with a small profitability anchor but avoid close/open reversal to test a slower operational-quality mechanism.
notes: Distinct from ROE parent by using inventory efficiency as dominant signal.

name: v9_asset_growth_conservative
hypothesis: Aggressive asset growth can signal overinvestment. Penalize fast asset expansion and add a small quality anchor to avoid distressed low-growth firms.
expression: 0.70 * group_rank(-1 * ts_rank(ts_delta(assets, 252) / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Fama-French investment-style branch; should not rely on close/open reversal.

name: v9_low_leverage_low_systematic_risk
hypothesis: Balance-sheet safety and lower market-driven risk may identify durable firms. Use debt and systematic risk rather than payout/EPS fields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_st / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * systematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Safety branch; previous risk+quality was weak, but debt/risk combined may be cleaner.

name: v9_sales_estimate_disagreement_quality
hypothesis: Lower analyst sales-estimate dispersion relative to expected sales may proxy forecast confidence. This is analyst data but not EPS yield.
expression: 0.70 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * sales_estimate_stddev_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Analyst disagreement branch; watch correlation with EPS active but mechanism differs from yield.

name: v9_competitor_authority_quality
hypothesis: Competitor authority may capture competitive-network position. Remove close/open reversal from the v8 graph branch and pair with a light quality anchor to reduce v7 correlation.
notes: Different from v8 competitor hub and lower parent-reversal exposure; submit only if correlation is clearly below threshold.

name: v9_vwap_reversion_quality
hypothesis: VWAP dislocation can capture short-term liquidity pressure. Pair with a small quality anchor and high decay to control turnover.
expression: 0.65 * rank(-1 * ts_decay_linear(close / vwap, 10)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: QuantGPT-inspired but distinct from close/open reversal; turnover/correlation gate is critical.
